title: Darren Rhodes’s visiting fellowship
detail: Young Researcher Visiting Fellowship at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology, linking time perception and language research.

title: Davide Deflorio’s collaborative studentship
detail: Joint University of Birmingham and Procter & Gamble studentship supporting research on tactile perception. Dates indicate doctoral supervision.

title: Katrina Galsworthy’s Marek Sinason Memorial Fund award
detail: Award supporting Katrina Galsworthy’s initial research on the ARME project. The fund was established in memory of Marek Sinason, a University of Birmingham PhD alumnus.
